Premise corrected · area a4-U · 2026-11-24T16:23Z · authorized by the seat session `session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ` (seat repo:objectstack#4, message to this zone at 2026-11-24T16:22Z: narrow to the menu rename, readings below as evidence)

- **Original premise:** a source-language design-mode rename of a menu item **or a record tab** whose label is an inline locale map writes a plain string over the whole map.
- **Readings at `origin/main` a73edb3c (unchanged on these paths at 8e4ac50d):**
  - Menu: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx:636-641` sets `patch.label` to the typed string and `patchEntry` replaces `entry.label` wholesale; nothing in `patchEntry` / `splitLabelEdits` (`designModeMenuModel.ts:782-815`) merges into a map. `labelGoesToTranslation` (`designModeMenuModel.ts:753-762`) sends a source-language rename to the stored label only when the served label equals the stored one (`JSON.stringify` compare). Whether `translateApp` serves an inline map as a resolved string — which would route the rename to a translation item and keep the map — is **not measured**; the dev measures it before writing code.
  - Record tabs: `relatedLists[].label` is `z.string().min(1).optional()` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1366`); an inline locale map is not a legal value there, so the record-tab half has no stored map to lose.
- **Corrected scope:** the menu rename only (app navigation `label` is `I18nLabelSchema`, `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:333`, which admits an inline map). Goal unchanged. Acceptance reads: a source-language rename over an inline locale-map menu label replaces only the source-language entry and keeps the other locales' values; a test pins it.
- **If the measurement shows the map already survives** (the rename routes to a translation item), the premise is falsified: the card is released with that reading, not built elsewhere.
